description: Read China Supply Check: free preparation accepts a reference image or existing text/model request in the customer's own language; Chinese and supplier-platform terminology are not required. Public human photo preview: https://api.seekapi.ai/checkout/stripe/image. Live image-provider execution remains separately gated pending controlled acceptance; image payment is locked and PUBLIC IMAGE CARD OFF. Paid image delivery returns 1–3 evidence-backed distinct suppliers; 1–2 is a completed shortage, zero is still refining. Existing text/model results target three RFQ-worthy candidates. Published prices are not supplier-confirmed quotes; MOQ is information only. 2.99 USDC on Base or USD2.99 hosted card payment. Existing Agent text x402 payment is currently disabled. Current x402 order reads require signed-wallet authentication.
name: discover_china_supply_check_v0
